audit.notes: Auto-converted from OPPO Gallery JSON with a visual audit: right band 50 rotated 90deg (vendor direction=2 + rotation=90 + height=50 + rightMargin=50), same geometry as the shipped 胶片 · 2 (personalize_film_2) card; only the bitmap differs. textSource 0 -> model, textSource 2 -> timeLocation, bitmap brand_imagine_dark (528x272) drawn into a 97x34 contain box.
unsupported: vendor paint.lightAlpha/darkAlpha dual alpha: IR keeps one alpha (0.54, the light-theme value the vendor JSON stores first)

vendor textSource 2 carries maxWidth 90 + layoutWeight 1 (the params line takes the leftover width); the IR has neither field, so the line is laid out by its own margin and can run past 90 reference px on long EXIF
vendor paint.fontName OplusSans / SysSans-En-Regular.ttf: engine font key 'sys' (StockSysSans) is the closest shipped face
bitmap scaleType 5 is reproduced as scale 'contain' (the 528x272 art is letterboxed inside the 97x34 box)
机型行（model）与日期地点行（timeLocation）只取照片 EXIF 的 Make/Model/DateTimeOriginal 与定位：照片缺这些字段时对应行为空、引擎不绘制，图案与已画出的行不受影响，与既有厂商卡行为一致
